lanes.summary: The diff accurately implements the required filter. By fetching the `files` array via `gh pr list --json` and filtering DIRTY PRs with `select(any(.files[]?; .path == "docs/roadmaps/roadmap.yaml"))`, it restricts the merge driver resolution script to PRs that actually touch the roadmap file. This perfectly aligns with the ticket's goal to prevent the by-ID driver from pointlessly attempting to resolve PRs whose conflicts are strictly elsewhere. Tests cover the expected exclusion logic accurately.

The diff implements the required selector refinement for ci_resolve_dirty.sh under PMAT-3118 (spec §6.4), ensuring that only DIRTY PRs that actually touch docs/roadmaps/roadmap.yaml are selected. All hermetic self-tests and static analysis gates pass, with no gates weakened or unrequested changes introduced.

findings.claim: gh_cmd requests the 'files' field from gh pr list --json to retrieve files changed by candidate PRs
select_dirty filters candidates with select(any(.files[]?; .path == "docs/roadmaps/roadmap.yaml")) in both --pr and general selection branches
Hermetic self-test passes 11/11 rows, verifying that DIRTY PRs not touching docs/roadmaps/roadmap.yaml are excluded in general selection and when explicitly passed via --pr 104
